profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Branch
profile.summary: Has a proven track record of a successful self-starter and team builder in a bootstrapped startup as a sole founding engineer - built the sustainable systems and products from scratch and contributed to strong growth of the company and the engineering team. Obsessed with data, performance, efficiency, scalability, forward thinking, pragmatism, collaboration, and innovation

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed, implemented, and owned a core bundle delivery platform for 150M+ mobile devices, with support for incremental update, prioritization, versioning, and experimentation
• Successfully launched a new monetized product from scratch, driving revenue growth
• Led organization-wide cost reduction initiatives that reduced AWS costs by 25%
• Refactored legacy systems to scalable microservices and built and improved reusable integration test framework
• Led the post-mortem process and implemented a tag-based deployment process via CI/CD
• AWS, Kubernetes, Bazel, Kotlin, Python, Airflow, Spark, Pandas, Kafka, PostgreSQL, Presto, Redis, Elasticsearch, GitHub Actions, Prometheus, Grafana
positions.insights: Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microservices and +16 skills

positions.title: Sole Founding Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and built infrastructure, sustainable software systems, and products from scratch with patented technology for a profitable startup, and contributed to building and mentoring our successful engineering team
• Developed systems that provide services that detect online brand and trademark abuse and marketing violation by monitoring paid search, website content, and coupon code sites.
• Developed large-scale web crawling and analyzing systems, and alerting/reporting/tracking systems, automated configuration, development tools, deployment, auto-scaling, and cloud management systems.
• Django (MVC framework), Linux, Apache, Nginx, MySQL (Aurora), PostgreSQL,  Cassandra, Redis, DynamoDB, RedShift/Spectrum, Spark, RabbitMQ, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, Kibana, Chef, Vagrant, Python in distributed/cloud computing environments (Amazon’s SQS, S3, EC2, Lambda, Kinesis, VPC)
positions.insights: Software as a Service (SaaS), Distributed Systems and +13 skills

patents.title: AFFILIATE INVESTIGATION SYSTEM AND METHOD
patents.description: Given an advertisement placed by a rogue affiliate that takes steps to hide its affiliate ID from affiliate investigators, the affiliate ID may be identified using a step-wise link follower to process the advertisement's target URIs. For each redirection step inclusively between the original target URI and the ultimate destination URI, the current URI is analyzed and requested according to either a trusted request method or a non-trusted request method depending on whether the resource to which the URI refers is known to be a trusted resource. The non-trusted request method is designed to thwart the rogue affiliate's efforts to identify an affiliate investigator as the source of the request.
